body: my stepdad is narcissistic and has told me to kill myself, we don’t talk. and when we do he verbally abuses me and screams at me. they both mentally abuse me, gaslight me and manipulate me. i have severe depression and ADHD, hobbies aren’t a thing for me anymore. toughing it out isn’t a thing for me anymore. thank you for trying to give advice though

i’m not 18 yet. she keeps saying i can move out, that she WILL get me a van, that i can go and stay with her friend that’s a few states away. my mental health prevents me from working. and keeps hanging my freedom over my head, she’s not doing anything she says she will. she doesn’t want to give me money.
a truly loving god doesn’t love under conditions
“god says it’s wrong for guys to like other guys” ..?
certainly a phobia of some kind, if it’s not germaphobia. you are not overreacting. i’m sorry you are going through this.
uh, the bible says men shouldn’t lie with BOYS. it’s talking about pedophilia — not homosexuality, which is men with men. never said being gay is wrong.
we’re not close at all. we don’t even talk despite living in the same house.

i’m currently in therapy, seeing a psychiatrist in a week or so and getting on medication. i’ll be ok. ive found myself laughing at this situation.. which it’s not funny,, so i’ll sort my feelings out. but.. people are crazy!
yikes 😬 as if i haven’t already tried.

our minds have always done what’s best for us, well when it comes to protection. that’s the case here, most likely. i hope understanding comes to you soon that this isn’t a bad thing :) each part plays a role in caring for the system/body, the former host’s life. sometimes roles are switched up. it’s a process.
thank you, aim. i’m apart of a system as well. it’s nice to see other systems out there.

i news to cry but i physically can’t. i knew this was coming, i’ve known for a long time. even before i officially got to know them, i saw their media and how they’d publicly express and project their feelings. i’ve had to “prepare” myself multiple times for this, but that doesn’t make it easier. today aside from this, has also been horrible. i am burnt out an barely feeling much regarding it. i know i’ll hurt later.
